sections.excerpt:

you invest in our Class A Ordinary Shares, your interest will be diluted to the extent of the difference between this offering price
per Class A Ordinary Share and our net tangible book value per Class A Ordinary Share after this offering. Dilution results from the
fact that this offering price per Class A Ordinary Share is substantially in excess of the book value per Class A Ordinary Share attributable
to the existing shareholders for our presently outstanding Class A Class A Ordinary Share. Our net tangible book value
